caption: Il Gigante and Fegina beach, Monterosso
composition: Il Gigante cliff statue above the sandy Fegina beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the sand of Fegina beach, the camera frames the colossal stone figure of Il Gigante carved into the cliff at the left, the bearded sea-god towering over the shoreline in the soft 08:21 morning light. The empty beach sweeps across the foreground to the water's edge, while pastel seafront buildings line the right and a pink villa with dark cypresses crowns the green hill at center. Broken clouds drift overhead, and gentle waves lap the shore at the lower left.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Il Gigante and Monterosso beach under partly cloudy morning light
